messages.subject: Link shiny web app to my blog
parts:
Hello all, I have create a simple blog and would like to link the web application to my blog. So that users can use r application through my blog. Can any body help me or advise me on this. 

Thanks, Savi

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Link shiny web app to my blog
parts:
You would want to include your application in an iframe on your page.  You can see an example of such an arrangement here:  http://www.rstudio.com/shiny/


<iframe id="example1" src="http://youraccount.shinyapps.io/yourappname" style="border: none; width: 440px; height: 500px"></iframe>
